testcase.name: mmc-timeout
testcase.failure:
The host controller gets no answer from the card. For an SD slot: card missing or not seated, card-detect wired wrong, no card supply. For eMMC: VCC/VCCQ missing, a broken CLK/CMD line, or solder joints under the eMMC.

testcase.name: eth-phy
testcase.failure:
The MAC cannot talk to the PHY over MDIO. Check the PHY supply and its reset line, the reference clock (25/50 MHz), the MDIO/MDC solder joints and the PHY address strapping.
